scope.summary: Per-relation OLS / Real Application Security / Data Redaction detection on the read path: positive policy evidence refuses before execution with protected_by_ols / protected_by_ras / protected_by_redaction; unreadable evidence follows the orchestrator's R36 ruling (default admit with security_feature_evidence: unavailable + keyed observation + audit record; require_security_feature_evidence = true restores the security_feature_visibility_unknown refusal); doctor check 20 warns when the account cannot read the evidence sources.
out_of_scope: OLS and RAS live refusal on FREE 23ai (image cannot enable them; unit + catalog proof only, per the bead's no-claim).

Single --case runs, stdio + Streamable HTTP each: free23 w4_query_redaction_policy_table_refused_no_execution, w4_query_redaction_nested_exists_refused_no_execution (FORBIDDEN_STATEMENT, structured_reason.category PROTECTED_BY_REDACTION, audit_zero_executions true, V$SQL marker absent), w4_query_security_catalog_unreadable_admitted (rows ID=1 + security_feature_evidence=unavailable naming the relation; exact five-record audit set), w4_query_security_catalog_unreadable_strict_refused (security_feature_visibility_unknown) -> all pass; xe21 and xe18 redaction-table + admitted cases pass; full dictionary family 82/82 on each of free23/xe21/xe18.

entry_points.trace: cargo test -p oraclemcp-db --lib -> 667 passed, including ols_policy_on_relation_refused, ras_realm_on_relation_refused, redaction_policy_on_relation_refused, nested_subquery_relation_with_redaction_refused, feature_not_installed_evidence_allows, security_view_unreadable_is_unknown_refused_when_strict, security_view_unreadable_is_unknown_available_to_default_read_policy. cargo test -p oraclemcp-core --lib -> 824 passed incl. doctor::security_feature_catalog_visibility_tests::unreadable_security_catalog_warns_by_default_and_fails_when_strict.

limitations: Acceptance box 'With the security catalog view unreadable, the SELECT is refused (Unknown)' is met only for profiles with require_security_feature_evidence = true; the default admits with an observation per the orchestrator's 2026-09-25 R36 ruling recorded on the bead, which supersedes the frozen box text.
OLS and RAS refusals are proven by unit tests with scripted catalog rows only; no live OLS/RAS lane exists.
The W4 fixture principal for the redaction cases is the lab SYSTEM account; the least-privilege path is covered by the admitted/strict cases (synthetic cross account) and the E2E_ORACLE doctor run.
